about: Issue #689 (ADR-106), review of #692: the refusal of a package as a new item's single unit, by unit name. RetailNewItemPacksIT checks RetailCatalogue.packageAsUnit against it and new-item-packs.dom.test.tsx checks the PWA's packageAsUnit, so the server and the screen word it the same. Every short code PACKAGE_WORDS refuses reads as its word. Issue #709 (ADR-110): 'Choose a single unit', and Roll is a package.
